title: Physics-informed neural networks for spacecraft trajectory optimization with exact boundary conditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.21933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We use neural networks to optimize trajectories by modeling the position as a function of time and minimizing the thrust with respect to the network parameters. This corresponds to an unsupervised training procedure in which physical laws are incorporated directly into the optimization objective. In standard physics-informed neural networks, initial and terminal states are enforced through additional weighted loss terms, resulting in a multi-objective optimization problem that is highly sensitive to the choice of loss weights and can lead to poor convergence and reduced accuracy. To address this challenge, we construct a simple transformation, exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization problems, to enforce boundary conditions exactly a-priori. translated_title: 具有精确边界条件的物理信息神经网络航天器轨迹优化方法
translated_abstract: 我们利用神经网络来优化轨迹，将位置建模为时间的函数，并相对于网络参数最小化推力。这对应于一种无监督训练过程，其中物理定律被直接纳入优化目标。在标准的物理信息神经网络中，初始状态和终端状态通过额外的加权损失项来强制执行，这导致了一个多目标优化问题，该问题对损失权重的选择高度敏感，可能导致收敛性差和精度降低。为了解决这一挑战，我们利用轨迹优化问题的数学结构，构造了一个简单的变换，以便先验地精确强制执行边界条件。该变换可以被解释为解空间的一种重新参数化，它将边界条件直接嵌入到函数中。这将原始……
tldr: 该论文提出一种利用轨迹优化问题数学结构的简单变换方法，将边界条件先验地精确嵌入神经网络解空间中，避免了标准物理信息神经网络中加权损失项敏感导致的收敛性和精度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simple transformation exploiting the mathematical structure of trajectory optimization to embed boundary conditions exactly a-priori into the neural network, avoiding the weight-sensitivity and convergence issues of standard physics-informed neural networks.
